starting_point: Original publisher Qwen3-8B for every candidate; no prior SFT adapter initialization

DEV.scope: Adaptive development, not independent; original32 plus14 operator-selected auxiliary CLI fixtures. Family-macro score reduces repeated-variant dominance.

old_retention.hard_floor: Old native >= paired E0-2points, historical correct retained>=11/13, paired E0 correct retained>=ceil(.8*n). No candidate earlyEOS/truncation on110rows.

score.operational_utility: Mean over task groups of confirmed fixture PASS fraction, times100. UNKNOWN contributes no confirmed utility and is reported separately, not labelled semantically wrong.
score.comparison: Same scoring for E0,fixedSFT and ABA candidates; retain highest eligible among all, ties keep existing fixed/E0. Native selected candidate and host-retained model reported separately.

training.recipe_choice: Native ABA Designer/Worker chooses two distinct permitted LR recipes; trusted backend executes fixed trainer. Bounded hyperparameter-search pilot, not autonomous data synthesis.
training.fairness: Total ABA update budget equals prior fixed256; selected candidate has<=128 updates. Same rows/CE exposure overall, two fresh initializations; actual GPU wall/optimizer time measured separately. Not claimed equal end-to-end wall/FLOPs.

final_confirmation.source: Previously reserved release confirmation384, if manifest/audits still show no prior model query
final_confirmation.compare: OriginalE0,fixedSFT256,native-selected candidate once each unique weights;0 furthertraining/selection using confirmation
final_confirmation.if_prior_queries_found: Report contamination and do not call it independent; no relabelling as fresh
final_confirmation.quality: Same authored generator; not source-separated expert gold

native_requirements: Pinned ABA framework with unchanged native guards/verifiers/reviewers
Native Worker dispatch receipts and actual nonzero updates
No cached SFT is counted as a fresh native candidate
